alternatives.cosyvoice: Actual generator input exists only CosyVoice2/3 non-vLLM; not deployed or benchmarked on this Windows host. ZipVoice reference synthesis is not a substitute for true incremental text input.
alternatives.hf_phonemes: Pinned upstream defaults to English with 0.5s buffering. No validated Chinese viseme model, no production substitution.
alternatives.omni_duplex: Moshi, GLM-4-Voice, Qwen3-Omni, MiniCPM-o and vLLM-Omni are alternative inference architectures, not features to run simultaneously. No compatible model/hardware real-time validation completed.
